adaptations: Source matching helpers use read-only connections and explicit paths.
Input samples share obscured site IDs; private spatial matching is described and provided as callable helpers.
Soil terrain and carbon use the existing perturbed values; reflectance and climate are perturbed before harmonization.
Source functions are retained for band alignment, QA decoding, LOWESS, nearest-point distances, and fire time alignment.
Soil joins use the model reflectance bands and precomputed perturbed aspect sine/cosine.
Fire histograms use bubble radii and bins from the included checkpoint.
Fire sample uses only complete observed days and full forecast windows.
